# pulumi CLI reference

`ModularPipelines.Pulumi` provides strongly typed access to the `pulumi` CLI.

## Executable prerequisite

This package does not install the `pulumi` executable. Install it separately and ensure `pulumi` is available on `PATH`.

Follow the executable's official documentation for installation instructions.

## Package installation

```shell
dotnet add package ModularPipelines.Pulumi
```

Resolve the service with `context.Tools.Pulumi`.
Projects using C# 13 or another .NET language can use `context.Tools.Get<ModularPipelines.Pulumi.Services.IPulumi>()` instead.

## Module example

Resolve the service in a module, then select a command from the table below. A runnable example is omitted when no command has complete safety metadata:

```csharp
var pulumi = context.Tools.Pulumi;
```
